description: This file contains the implementation of Memory Protection Unit (MPU) management for ARM64 architecture in Zephyr RTOS, including enabling/disabling MPU, configuring regions from device tree, dynamic region management, and thread-specific MPU setup.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_enable
methods.description: Enables the MPU by setting the SCTLR_M_BIT in the system control register.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_disable
methods.description: Disables the MPU by clearing the SCTLR_M_BIT in the system control register.

methods.name: mpu_init
methods.description: Initializes MPU memory attributes for device, flash, SRAM, and non-cacheable regions.

methods.name: region_init
methods.description: Configures an MPU region with specified base, limit, and attributes.

methods.name: mpu_configure_regions_from_dt
methods.description: Programs MPU regions based on device tree memory attributes.

methods.name: z_arm64_mm_init
methods.description: Default MPU configuration for primary core, including fixed and device tree regions, and dynamic regions if enabled.

methods.name: dynamic_regions_init
methods.description: Initializes dynamic region info structures for each CPU.

methods.name: dynamic_areas_init
methods.description: Sets up dynamic memory regions within specified start and size.

methods.name: flush_dynamic_regions_to_mpu
methods.description: Flushes dynamic regions to the MPU hardware registers.

methods.name: configure_dynamic_mpu_regions
methods.description: Configures MPU regions for a specific thread, including domain partitions and stack guards.
